<!-- closer-core/v1 repair-of=stranske/Portable-Alpha-Extension-Model#2375@2380 -->
Refs #2375

<!-- workflow-source:local_request -->

The prior bundle regression accepted an empty artifact bundle. It now parses the actual schema, requires the completed workbook, checks referenced files and independent SHA-256 hashes, compares copied workbook bytes, and loads/verifies the bundle. Removing the CLI workbook registration produces `assert (True and {})`; restoring it passes.

Additional tests follow the issue's ranked CLI target and expose a real fallback bug: detailed-attribution failure raised `NameError` because `np` is type-checking-only. The runtime bootstrap imports NumPy as `_np`; the one-token fix uses that existing import. The regression compares exported fallback totals with the workbook's raw return sheets. No other production behavior changes.

## Acceptance, date and bounded stop

Check date: **2026-11-03 America/Chicago**. [Plan recorded before implementation](https://github.com/stranske/Portable-Alpha-Extension-Model/blob/28b9b47728b819e9c1eaf087890a5b2c1ca59f15/docs/evidence/issue-2375-closer-repair/acceptance-plan.txt).

Outcome: a real seeded single-run input produces a valid completed workbook bundle, loss of registration fails the test, all collected cases have production break/fail/restore/pass evidence, and final-head hosted Gate passes.

Command: `/opt/anaconda3/bin/python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_coverage_round_2375.py`.
This provisioned worktree has no `.venv/bin/python`; the owner-selected fallback is Python 3.12. Hosted Gate uses Python 3.14. Local results do not substitute for hosted acceptance.

Stop after three failures at the same step or 75 minutes from 18:23:05 CST. No local full-suite, release or verify run.

## Criteria

- [x] The bundle test validates recorded completed artifacts and fails when their registration is removed.
- [x] Every new collected case has identifiable production mutations, expected failures, and restored passes.
- [ ] Repository-ranked targets have measured Gate coverage deltas or concrete meaningful-coverage exception explanations.
- [ ] The actual CI formatting checks and pytest suite pass on the final head.

## Prior work retained and discarded

Started on current main `7613ffd9` on provisioned branch `closer-r3/issue-2375`. Merged both local branches containing commits absent from main: `closer/issue-2375@fd0f7328` and `closer-r1/issue-2375@aac4e80b`.

Retained #2460's useful schema/file assertions, its full historical transcripts, and r1's hash-validation intent (using independent hashlib rather than production's private hash helper). Discarded duplicate weaker assertions, dead runner helpers, and unsupported prior acceptance/ranking claims. Fixed the mutation runner's actual CI lint errors (unused `sys`/`viz`) while making it record exact mutations and bounded subprocess results. Merged #2380 is preserved.

[Full #2460 inspection](https://github.com/stranske/Portable-Alpha-Extension-Model/blob/28b9b47728b819e9c1eaf087890a5b2c1ca59f15/docs/evidence/issue-2375-closer-repair/initial-ci-inspection.json): it is **open, not landed**. [Gate 41579542074](https://github.com/stranske/Portable-Alpha-Extension-Model/actions/runs/41579542074) failed Ruff in its mutation runner; hosted pytest itself reported 1962 passed, 1 skipped. Prior checked boxes were not acceptance evidence.

## Mutation evidence

[Full current transcripts: 25 selected failures + 25 restored passes](https://github.com/stranske/Portable-Alpha-Extension-Model/blob/28b9b47728b819e9c1eaf087890a5b2c1ca59f15/docs/evidence/issue-2375-closer-repair/current-mutation-transcripts.md).
[Reproduction runner](https://github.com/stranske/Portable-Alpha-Extension-Model/blob/28b9b47728b819e9c1eaf087890a5b2c1ca59f15/docs/evidence/issue-2375-closer-repair/run_mutations.py).
[Historical transcripts retained verbatim](https://github.com/stranske/Portable-Alpha-Extension-Model/blob/28b9b47728b819e9c1eaf087890a5b2c1ca59f15/docs/evidence/issue-2375-closer-repair/mutation-transcripts.md).

All four packet parameters are individually recorded: **RuntimeError, ImportError, ValueError, OSError**. The current matrix also covers malformed/missing comparison inputs, telemetry resilience, GIF conversion, missing dashboard, bundle registration removal, daily-index rejection, three dashboard launch failures, two GIF export failures, attribution fallback, two trade-off cases, two registry cases and two EOF suggestion cases. Mutations change production, never the test expectation. Every selected mutant exits 1 with its named failure, then exits 0 after restoration. The attribution mutation reinstates the actual `np` bug.

## Ranked Gate measurements

[Authoritative ranking](https://github.com/stranske/Portable-Alpha-Extension-Model/blob/28b9b47728b819e9c1eaf087890a5b2c1ca59f15/docs/evidence/issue-2375-closer-repair/ranking-provenance.json): (1) `pa_core/llm/compare_runs.py`, (2) `pa_core/cli.py`, from issue #2375.

[Settings and exceptions](https://github.com/stranske/Portable-Alpha-Extension-Model/blob/28b9b47728b819e9c1eaf087890a5b2c1ca59f15/docs/evidence/issue-2375-closer-repair/gate-measurements.json).
[Hosted baseline JSON](https://github.com/stranske/Portable-Alpha-Extension-Model/blob/28b9b47728b819e9c1eaf087890a5b2c1ca59f15/docs/evidence/issue-2375-closer-repair/gate-baseline.json), extracted from [Gate 41696059356](https://github.com/stranske/Portable-Alpha-Extension-Model/actions/runs/41696059356), artifact 13261601545. Its PR source tree equals starting main (`git diff ff7cb957 origin/main` was empty).
Final hosted measurements will be entered here after CI completes.

| Ranked target | Current-main Gate missing statements | Final-head Gate missing statements |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| `pa_core/llm/compare_runs.py` | 1 | pending |
| `pa_core/cli.py` | 165 | pending |

Gate explicitly uses **branch=false**, product sources `pa_core`, `dashboard`, `design-system`, Python 3.14.9, coverage 7.17.0, and `-n auto --dist=loadgroup` (two workers observed). Missing branches are **unmeasured**, not zero.

The separate identical-settings focused branch probes are [before](https://github.com/stranske/Portable-Alpha-Extension-Model/blob/28b9b47728b819e9c1eaf087890a5b2c1ca59f15/docs/evidence/issue-2375-closer-repair/focused-branches-before.json) and [after](https://github.com/stranske/Portable-Alpha-Extension-Model/blob/28b9b47728b819e9c1eaf087890a5b2c1ca59f15/docs/evidence/issue-2375-closer-repair/focused-branches-after.json). CLI missing statements 556→449, missing branches 191→169; comparison 83/48→83/48. These are only the changed test module, **not full Gate**. Its executed lines include 64 statements missed in the current-main Gate baseline.

Concrete exception: `compare_runs.py:140` formats the private `_MISSING` sentinel, but the only code generating that sentinel now formats it directly in `_config_snapshot_diff`. Other public formatter paths pass ordinary values/None. A private-sentinel-only test would pad coverage without representing real input.

Concrete unreachable CLI branch: sweep sensitivity at lines 1500–1522 requires `args.sensitivity`, inside a route requiring `not args.sensitivity`. Production routing is unchanged. The new CLI cases cover meaningful reachable boundaries instead.

Historical context, verified from [baseline job 117210972329](https://github.com/stranske/Portable-Alpha-Extension-Model/actions/runs/38971176069/job/117210972329): round-open missing counts were 11 and 211 (222 combined). That run used Python 3.12 and an older comparison source. It is historical context, not a controlled current-main/repair comparison. The current repository already exceeds 90% overall; this explicitly requested repair completes artifact correctness, discriminating evidence and a real fallback fix.

## Local command output

[Full local output](https://github.com/stranske/Portable-Alpha-Extension-Model/blob/28b9b47728b819e9c1eaf087890a5b2c1ca59f15/docs/evidence/issue-2375-closer-repair/local-validation.txt).

```text
$ /opt/anaconda3/bin/python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_coverage_round_2375.py
25 passed, 263 warnings in 5.25s
exit=0

$ /opt/anaconda3/bin/python3 -m ruff check --output-format github --extend-exclude .workflows-lib .
(no output)
exit=0

$ /opt/anaconda3/bin/python3 -m ruff format --check tests/test_coverage_round_2375.py pa_core/cli.py docs/evidence/issue-2375-closer-repair/run_mutations.py
3 files already formatted
exit=0

$ /opt/anaconda3/bin/python3 -m black --check --line-length 100 --exclude '(\.venv|\.workflows-lib|node_modules)' tests/test_coverage_round_2375.py pa_core/cli.py docs/evidence/issue-2375-closer-repair/run_mutations.py
All done! 3 files would be left unchanged.
exit=0
```

Black additionally warns that the local Python 3.12 AST check cannot parse all Python 3.13 target syntax. No bypass flag was used. Gate sets `format_check: false`, so its Black job is skipped; the actual required Ruff command above was run across the repository. Captured pytest stdout contains trailing spaces, retained as literal evidence.

## Hosted final-head validation

Pending on `28b9b47728b819e9c1eaf087890a5b2c1ca59f15`. The exact full pytest command runs **only in CI**, respecting the local resource restriction:

```sh
pytest -p ci_test_growth --junitxml=pytest-junit.xml --cov --cov-config=pyproject.toml --cov-report=xml:coverage.xml --cov-report=term-missing --cov-report=json:coverage.json -n auto --dist=loadgroup
```
